sentences.en: Hello, my name is Rocio and I am from El Salvador.
sentences.cn: 你好，我叫罗西奥，来自萨尔瓦多。

sentences.en: My question is, do you buy dinner at the supermarket?
sentences.cn: 我的问题是：你会在超市买晚饭吗？

sentences.en: Do I buy dinner at the supermarket?
Sometimes whenever I'm busy, I buy dinner.
sentences.cn: 有时候一忙起来，我就会买。

sentences.en: At the supermarket, they have pre-made foods that are very easy to heat up.
sentences.cn: 超市里有做好的现成食物，热一热就能吃，很方便。

sentences.en: I like to buy sushi or rice with vegetables, but I don't like to buy fast food because it's not very healthy.
sentences.cn: 我喜欢买寿司，或者蔬菜炒饭，但我不太爱买快餐，因为不太健康。

sentences.en: I also don't like frozen meals because they don't taste really fresh.
sentences.cn: 我也不喜欢冷冻食品，味道总感觉不够新鲜。

sentences.en: So I buy vegetables and chicken and cook at home.
sentences.cn: 所以我会买些蔬菜和鸡肉，回家自己做。

sentences.en: The supermarket is very convenient for me whenever I am busy because it has many options for pre-made food.
sentences.cn: 对我来说，忙的时候超市真的很方便，因为现成的食物选择挺多。

sentences.en: But I prefer to cook if there is time.
sentences.cn: 不过只要时间来得及，我还是更愿意自己做饭。

sentences.en: And do you buy dinner at the supermarket?
sentences.cn: 那么，你会在超市买晚饭吗？
